city_fields.supportSceneAlt: A doula supporting an expectant mom in Sunnyvale, CA: birth support and doula care
city_fields.culture: Sunnyvale is a Silicon Valley city in Santa Clara County, California. Families in Sunnyvale typically deliver at El Camino Hospital in Mountain View (Level III NICU) or Kaiser Permanente Santa Clara Medical Center (Level III NICU). California's Medi-Cal program covers doula services statewide.
city_fields.medicaidNote: Yes — California's Medi-Cal program has covered full-spectrum doula services as a preventive benefit since January 1, 2023, including prenatal and postpartum visits, labor and delivery support, and support for miscarriage, stillbirth, and abortion. Enrolled doulas bill Medi-Cal through the Department of Health Care Services. Sunnyvale families on Medi-Cal can access enrolled providers in Santa Clara County, including Sunnyvale-based doulas listed in the state DHCS doula directory.
